chapterInfo.content:
22
Ɔhene ba ayeforɔhyia
(Luka 14.16-24)
1Na Yesu kasa kyerɛɛ wɔn mmebuo mu bio sɛ: 2#Yoh 3.29 Ɔsoro ahennie te sɛ ɔhene bi a ɔtoo ayeforɔ pono maa ne ba. 3Na ɔsomaa ne nkoa sɛ wɔnkɔfrɛ wɔn a wɔato nsa afrɛ wɔn sɛ wɔmmra ayeforɔ no ase no, nanso wɔampɛ sɛ wɔba. 4#Mat 21.36 Bio ɔsomaa nkoa foforɔ sɛ: Monkɔka nkyerɛ wɔn a wɔahyia wɔn no sɛ: Hwɛ, masiesie m’aduane, wɔakum m’anantwie ne me nyɛmmoa, na wɔawie nnoɔma nyinaa; mommra ayeforɔ no ase! 5Na wɔn deɛ, wɔamfa anyɛ hwee, na wɔkokɔe. Obi kɔɔ n’afuo mu, na obi nso kɔdii ne dwa. 6Na wɔn a aka no kyekyeree ne nkoa no bɔɔ wɔn adapaa kunkumm wɔn. 7#Mat 24.2 Na ɔhene no teeɛ no, ne bo fuiɛ, na ɔsomaa ne dɔm maa wɔkɔkunkumm awudifoɔ no, na wɔhyee wɔn kuro. 8Ɛnna ɔsee ne nkoa no sɛ: Wɔasiesie ayeforɔhyia no deɛ, nanso wɔn a wɔhyiaa wɔn no, ansɛ wɔn. 9#Mat 13.47; 21.43 Enti monkɔ atempɔn nkwanta so, na dodoɔ a mobɛhu wɔn no, momfrɛ wɔn mmra ayeforɔ no ase. 10Na nkoa no firii adi kɔɔ akwan so, kɔboaboaa dodoɔ a wɔhunuu wɔn no ano, nnipa bɔne ne nnipa pa; na ahɔhoɔ bɛhyɛɛ ayeforɔhyia dan no ma.
11 Na ɔhene no baa mu bɛhwɛɛ ahɔhoɔ no, ɔbɛhunuu onipa bi a ɔnhyɛ ayeforɔhyia atadeɛ wɔ hɔ. 12Na ɔbisaa no sɛ: Awɛ, wobaa mu ha sɛn ni, na wonhyɛ ayeforɔhyia atadeɛ yi? Na ɔtɔree mum. 13#Mat 8.12 Ɛnna ɔhene no see asomfoɔ no sɛ: Monkyekyere ne nan ne ne nsa mfa no, nkɔto no ntwene akyirikyiri sum no mu; ɛhɔ na osu ne setwerɛ wɔ. 14Na wɔn a wɔafrɛ wɔn no dɔɔso, nanso wɔn a wɔyi wɔn no deɛ, wɔyɛ kakraa bi.
Ɛtoɔ ho asɛmmisa
(Marko 12.13-17; Luka 20.20-26)
15Ɛno na Farisifoɔ no kɔ kɔtuu agyina sɛdeɛ wɔbɛsum no fidie wɔ kasa mu. 16#Mar 3.6 Na wɔsomaa wɔn asuafoɔ kaa Herodefoɔ no ho baa ne nkyɛn sɛ: Kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, yɛnim sɛ woyɛ ɔnokwafoɔ, na wokyerɛ Nyankopɔn kwan nokorɛ mu, nanso obiara asɛm mfa wo ho; na wonhwɛ nnipa anim. 17Enti kyerɛ yɛn deɛ wodwene. Ɛwɔ ho kwan sɛ wɔyi toɔ ma Kaesare anaasɛ wɔnnyi? 18Na Yesu hunuu wɔn amumuyɛ no, ɔkaa sɛ: Mo nyaatwomfoɔ, adɛn na moresɔ me ahwɛ? 19Momfa ɛtoɔ sika no bi mmɛkyerɛ me! Na wɔde denare brɛɛ no. 20Na ɔbisaa wɔn sɛ: Hwan mfonini ne n’atwerɛ nie? 21#Rom 13.7 Wɔse: Kaesare dea. Ɛnna ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Ɛnneɛ momfa Kaesare deɛ mma Kaesare ne Nyankopɔn deɛ mma Onyankopɔn! 22Na wɔteeɛ no, ɛyɛɛ wɔn nwanwa; na wɔgyaa no hɔ kɔeɛ.
Owusɔreɛ ho asɛmmisa
(Marko 12.18-27; Luka 20.27-40)
23 # Aso 23.6; 23.8 Da no ara na Sadukifoɔ a wɔka sɛ owusɔreɛ nni hɔ no baa ne nkyɛn bɛbisaa no 24#Deut 25.5-6 sɛ: Kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, Mose kaa sɛ: Sɛ obi wu na ɔnni mma a, ne nua nware ne yere no na ɔnwo mma mma ne nua no. 25Na anuanom baason bi tenaa yɛn nkyɛn ha. Deɛ ɔdi kan no waree, na ɔwui; wannya mma, na ɔgyaa ne yere maa ne nua. 26Saa ara nso na deɛ ɔtɔ so mmienu ne mmiɛnsa no yɛeɛ de kɔduruu nson no soɔ. 27Na wɔn nyinaa akyiri no, ɔbaa no nso wui. 28Enti owusɔreɛ mu no, nnipa nson no mu hwan na ɔbɛyɛ ne yerɛ? Ɛfiri sɛ wɔn nyinaa aware no. 29Na Yesu bua see wɔn sɛ: Mofom, na monnim twerɛ nsɛm ne Nyankopɔn tumi. 30Owusɔreɛ mu no, wɔnware na wɔmma awadeɛ na wɔte sɛ abɔfoɔ wɔ soro. 31Na ɛfa awufoɔ sɔreɛ ho deɛ, monkenkann deɛ Onyankopɔn kaeɛ no pɛn 32#Eks 3.6 sɛ: Mene Abraham Nyankopɔn ne Isak Nyankopɔn ne Yakob Nyankopɔn? Onyankopɔn nyɛ awufoɔ Nyankopɔn na mmom ateasefoɔ Nyankopɔn. 33Na nkurɔfoɔ akuakuo no teeɛ no, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ no yɛɛ wɔn ahodwiri.
Ɔdɔ ne mmara a ɛdi kan
(Marko 12.28-31; Luka 10.25-28)
34Na Farisifoɔ no tee sɛ wamua Sadukifoɔ no ano no, wɔkɔhyiaa faako. 35Na wɔn mu baako a ɔyɛ mmaranimfoɔ bisaa no de sɔɔ no hwɛɛ sɛ: 36Kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, mmara no mu kɛseɛ ne deɛ ɛwɔ he? 37#Deut 6.5 Na ɔsee no sɛ: Dɔ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn w’akoma nyinaa mu ne wo kra nyinaa mu ne w’adwene nyinaa mu! 38Yei ne mmara no mu kɛseɛ ne deɛ ɛdi kan. 39#Lew 19.18 Na deɛ ɛtɔ so mmienu te sɛ ɛno: Dɔ wo yɔnko sɛ wo ho! 40#Mat 7.12; Rom 13.10; Gal 5.14 Mmara nsɛm mmienu yi so na mmara ne adiyifoɔ no nyinaa gyina.
Dawid ba ho asɛmmisa
(Marko 12.35-37; Luka 20.41-44)
41Na Farisifoɔ no hyiaeɛ no, Yesu bisaa wɔn 42sɛ: Modwene Kristo no ho sɛn? Hwan ba ne no? Wɔsee no sɛ: Dawid. 43Ɔbisaa wɔn sɛ: Na afei adɛn na Dawid nam honhom mu frɛ no owura ka sɛ:
44 # Dwom 110.1; Mat 26.64 Awurade see me wura sɛ:
Tena me nifa
kɔsi sɛ mede w’atamfoɔ bɛgu wo nan ase?
45 Sɛ Dawid frɛ no owura a, na ɛyɛɛ dɛn na ɔyɛ ne ba? 46Na obiara antumi ammua no asɛm biara, nanso ɛfiri da no, obiara antumi ammisa no asɛm biara bio.

Na Yesu kasa kyerɛɛ wɔn mmebuo mu bio sɛ: Ɔsoro ahennie te sɛ ɔhene bi a ɔtoo ayeforɔ pono maa ne ba. Na ɔsomaa ne nkoa sɛ wɔnkɔfrɛ wɔn a wɔato nsa afrɛ wɔn sɛ wɔmmra ayeforɔ no ase no, nanso wɔampɛ sɛ wɔba. Bio ɔsomaa nkoa foforɔ sɛ: Monkɔka nkyerɛ wɔn a wɔahyia wɔn no sɛ: Hwɛ, masiesie m’aduane, wɔakum m’anantwie ne me nyɛmmoa, na wɔawie nnoɔma nyinaa; mommra ayeforɔ no ase! Na wɔn deɛ, wɔamfa anyɛ hwee, na wɔkokɔe. Obi kɔɔ n’afuo mu, na obi nso kɔdii ne dwa. Na wɔn a aka no kyekyeree ne nkoa no bɔɔ wɔn adapaa kunkumm wɔn. Na ɔhene no teeɛ no, ne bo fuiɛ, na ɔsomaa ne dɔm maa wɔkɔkunkumm awudifoɔ no, na wɔhyee wɔn kuro. Ɛnna ɔsee ne nkoa no sɛ: Wɔasiesie ayeforɔhyia no deɛ, nanso wɔn a wɔhyiaa wɔn no, ansɛ wɔn. Enti monkɔ atempɔn nkwanta so, na dodoɔ a mobɛhu wɔn no, momfrɛ wɔn mmra ayeforɔ no ase. Na nkoa no firii adi kɔɔ akwan so, kɔboaboaa dodoɔ a wɔhunuu wɔn no ano, nnipa bɔne ne nnipa pa; na ahɔhoɔ bɛhyɛɛ ayeforɔhyia dan no ma.
Na ɔhene no baa mu bɛhwɛɛ ahɔhoɔ no, ɔbɛhunuu onipa bi a ɔnhyɛ ayeforɔhyia atadeɛ wɔ hɔ. Na ɔbisaa no sɛ: Awɛ, wobaa mu ha sɛn ni, na wonhyɛ ayeforɔhyia atadeɛ yi? Na ɔtɔree mum. Ɛnna ɔhene no see asomfoɔ no sɛ: Monkyekyere ne nan ne ne nsa mfa no, nkɔto no ntwene akyirikyiri sum no mu; ɛhɔ na osu ne setwerɛ wɔ. Na wɔn a wɔafrɛ wɔn no dɔɔso, nanso wɔn a wɔyi wɔn no deɛ, wɔyɛ kakraa bi.


Ɛno na Farisifoɔ no kɔ kɔtuu agyina sɛdeɛ wɔbɛsum no fidie wɔ kasa mu. Na wɔsomaa wɔn asuafoɔ kaa Herodefoɔ no ho baa ne nkyɛn sɛ: Kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, yɛnim sɛ woyɛ ɔnokwafoɔ, na wokyerɛ Nyankopɔn kwan nokorɛ mu, nanso obiara asɛm mfa wo ho; na wonhwɛ nnipa anim. Enti kyerɛ yɛn deɛ wodwene. Ɛwɔ ho kwan sɛ wɔyi toɔ ma Kaesare anaasɛ wɔnnyi? Na Yesu hunuu wɔn amumuyɛ no, ɔkaa sɛ: Mo nyaatwomfoɔ, adɛn na moresɔ me ahwɛ? Momfa ɛtoɔ sika no bi mmɛkyerɛ me! Na wɔde denare brɛɛ no. Na ɔbisaa wɔn sɛ: Hwan mfonini ne n’atwerɛ nie? Wɔse: Kaesare dea. Ɛnna ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Ɛnneɛ momfa Kaesare deɛ mma Kaesare ne Nyankopɔn deɛ mma Onyankopɔn! Na wɔteeɛ no, ɛyɛɛ wɔn nwanwa; na wɔgyaa no hɔ kɔeɛ.


Da no ara na Sadukifoɔ a wɔka sɛ owusɔreɛ nni hɔ no baa ne nkyɛn bɛbisaa no sɛ: Kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, Mose kaa sɛ: Sɛ obi wu na ɔnni mma a, ne nua nware ne yere no na ɔnwo mma mma ne nua no. Na anuanom baason bi tenaa yɛn nkyɛn ha. Deɛ ɔdi kan no waree, na ɔwui; wannya mma, na ɔgyaa ne yere maa ne nua. Saa ara nso na deɛ ɔtɔ so mmienu ne mmiɛnsa no yɛeɛ de kɔduruu nson no soɔ. Na wɔn nyinaa akyiri no, ɔbaa no nso wui. Enti owusɔreɛ mu no, nnipa nson no mu hwan na ɔbɛyɛ ne yerɛ? Ɛfiri sɛ wɔn nyinaa aware no. Na Yesu bua see wɔn sɛ: Mofom, na monnim twerɛ nsɛm ne Nyankopɔn tumi. Owusɔreɛ mu no, wɔnware na wɔmma awadeɛ na wɔte sɛ abɔfoɔ wɔ soro. Na ɛfa awufoɔ sɔreɛ ho deɛ, monkenkann deɛ Onyankopɔn kaeɛ no pɛn sɛ: Mene Abraham Nyankopɔn ne Isak Nyankopɔn ne Yakob Nyankopɔn? Onyankopɔn nyɛ awufoɔ Nyankopɔn na mmom ateasefoɔ Nyankopɔn. Na nkurɔfoɔ akuakuo no teeɛ no, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ no yɛɛ wɔn ahodwiri.


Na Farisifoɔ no tee sɛ wamua Sadukifoɔ no ano no, wɔkɔhyiaa faako. Na wɔn mu baako a ɔyɛ mmaranimfoɔ bisaa no de sɔɔ no hwɛɛ sɛ: Kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, mmara no mu kɛseɛ ne deɛ ɛwɔ he? Na ɔsee no sɛ: Dɔ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn w’akoma nyinaa mu ne wo kra nyinaa mu ne w’adwene nyinaa mu! Yei ne mmara no mu kɛseɛ ne deɛ ɛdi kan. Na deɛ ɛtɔ so mmienu te sɛ ɛno: Dɔ wo yɔnko sɛ wo ho! Mmara nsɛm mmienu yi so na mmara ne adiyifoɔ no nyinaa gyina.


Na Farisifoɔ no hyiaeɛ no, Yesu bisaa wɔn sɛ: Modwene Kristo no ho sɛn? Hwan ba ne no? Wɔsee no sɛ: Dawid. Ɔbisaa wɔn sɛ: Na afei adɛn na Dawid nam honhom mu frɛ no owura ka sɛ:
Awurade see me wura sɛ:
Tena me nifa
kɔsi sɛ mede w’atamfoɔ bɛgu wo nan ase?
Sɛ Dawid frɛ no owura a, na ɛyɛɛ dɛn na ɔyɛ ne ba? Na obiara antumi ammua no asɛm biara, nanso ɛfiri da no, obiara antumi ammisa no asɛm biara bio.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
